# RPC Errors — 401

Telegram RPC exceptions with code `401`. Each exception page includes its constructor, metadata, and source docstring.

| Exception | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| [`ActiveUserRequired`](exceptions/401/active-user-required.md) | The method is only available to already activated users |
| [`AuthKeyInvalid`](exceptions/401/auth-key-invalid.md) | The key is invalid |
| [`AuthKeyPermEmpty`](exceptions/401/auth-key-perm-empty.md) | The method is unavailable for temporary authorization key, not bound to permanent |
| [`AuthKeyUnregistered`](exceptions/401/auth-key-unregistered.md) | The key is not registered in the system. Delete your session file and login again |
| [`SessionExpired`](exceptions/401/session-expired.md) | The authorization has expired |
| [`SessionPasswordNeeded`](exceptions/401/session-password-needed.md) | The two-step verification is enabled and a password is required |
| [`SessionRevoked`](exceptions/401/session-revoked.md) | The authorization has been invalidated, because of the user terminating all sessions |
| [`Unauthorized`](exceptions/401/unauthorized.md) | Unauthorized |
| [`UserDeactivated`](exceptions/401/user-deactivated.md) | The user has been deleted/deactivated |
| [`UserDeactivatedBan`](exceptions/401/user-deactivated-ban.md) | The user has been deleted/deactivated |
